---
title: "Assessment"
---

## Deliverables

Each group submits:

1. Julia code or notebook.
2. Short technical report.
3. Main plots.
4. Parameter table.
5. Explanation of assumptions.
6. Numerical method.
7. Verification or validation check.
8. Sensitivity study.
9. Engineering interpretation.

## Suggested Report Structure

1. Introduction
2. Problem definition
3. Physical assumptions
4. Governing equations
5. Numerical method
6. Julia implementation
7. Results
8. Verification and sensitivity analysis
9. Discussion
10. Conclusion
11. Appendix with code

## Grading Rubric

| Criterion | Weight |
|---|---:|
| Physical modeling | 25% |
| Numerical implementation | 25% |
| Verification and sensitivity analysis | 20% |
| Plots and engineering interpretation | 15% |
| Report clarity and reproducibility | 15% |

## Oral Presentation

Each group gives a 10–15 minute presentation covering:

- model assumptions,
- governing equations,
- numerical method,
- main results,
- verification,
- limitations,
- engineering conclusions.
